question: does a rib-indexed material frame exist, and how much does the delta-h map depend on choosing it over a spine-anchored one

measurand.name: soft_tissue_mm
measurand.definition: fat_mm + muscle_mm + other_mm along the lung-to-skin path
measurand.reason: D-044 merged fat and muscle into one tissue

rib.axial_coordinate: rib index plus fractional position to the next rib
rib.circumferential_coordinate: arc length along the rib from its vertebral end, normalised by that rib's total arc length
rib.reason: rib identity is preserved by anatomy and arc length along bone is invariant under rotation and bending, so the pair is a material coordinate that follows the tissue an electrode is glued to

spine.axial_coordinate: z of the skin point relative to the vertebral column extent
spine.circumferential_coordinate: angle around the per-slice body centroid, zero at anterior
spine.reason: the frame W2 already used; kept as the explicit comparison arm because the difference between the two maps measures the frame dependence directly

rib_identification.reason: cutting a midline slab separates the costovertebral junctions so the fused bone component breaks into individual ribs; elongation rejects scapula and clavicle

rib_preflight_gates.reason: a miscount shifts the whole map and produces a plausible but wrong delta; each gate breaks under a different miscount mode, and the arc-length gate directly tests the bone-does-not-stretch premise the circumferential coordinate relies on

preflight_policy.reason: same rule as the J1.2 truth preflight: no delta map is produced while the frame is unvalidated

comparison.primary: per-bin difference between the rib-frame and spine-frame delta-h maps
comparison.statistic: median and p90 of the absolute difference across bins occupied in both frames
comparison.interpretation: this difference is the frame-dependence term, previously only estimated as gradient times displacement

falsification_test.kind: rib index shifted by plus and minus one
falsification_test.rule: if shifting the rib index changes the delta-h map by less than the delta-h signal itself, the method does not discriminate a correct frame from a wrong one and the result is not reportable
falsification_test.statistic: ratio of the median absolute change under the shift to the median absolute delta-h

out_of_scope: any claim that delta-h is a validated respiratory effect before Gate 1B thresholds are frozen
changing the Gate 2 validity domain, which stays a separate frozen change
